title: 군사법원 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 군사법원 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Methods and Procedures for Perusal and Copying)
(1) After a judgment has become final, a person may peruse and copy judgment documents, etc. by applying to the military court that pronounced the judgment or by perusing and printing them through the military court's website. Provided, however, that where there are multiple defendants, perusal and copying may be conducted only after the judgments concerning all defendants have become final. [Amended on November 26, 2020.]
(2) A person who applies for perusal and copying at a military court under paragraph (1) shall pay the fee prescribed by the Rules on Perusal and Copying of Military Court Trial Records.
